about.title: A compact studio with serious attention to the final result.
about.description: Drvenija combines CNC precision and hand finishing to create products that need to look polished, sellable, and durable.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: Each piece starts with a clear technical drawing and ends with a manual quality check before dispatch.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.text: We handle both one-off custom pieces and small-batch production for retail, events, and interiors.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Lead times are set realistically and communicated early, especially for business and seasonal work.

process.title: From first idea to finished piece without last-minute improvisation.
process.description: We first align size and intended use, prepare the CNC-ready file, finish the edges, and inspect each piece before packing.

steps.define: We define the product use case, dimensions, and visual direction.
steps.prepare: We prepare the CNC-ready file and align material and thickness.
steps.finish: We cut, finish the edges, and inspect each piece before dispatch.
